verdict.rationale: Pricing docs confirm GrowthBook has an audit log feature ("Exportable audit logs") gated to Pro-tier and above, implying flag/config changes are tracked, and publishing/approval workflows also imply change tracking. However, there is no dedicated documentation describing the audit log's actual fields (who, what, when, old/new value) or how to access/query it beyond the pricing-page mention. Missing for 10: a dedicated audit-log doc page detailing captured fields, retention, and access; confirmation it covers every flag-value change (not just admin actions); independent/hands-on corroboration of audit log completeness.
